summary: Learn ISO 45003 risk assessment, wellbeing measurement, and practical workplace controls. Explore the five-day course outline and enrol with TrainingCred.
lede: Mental health at work training helps HR, occupational health and safety professionals, and people leaders identify psychosocial hazards and plan workplace responses. Participants practise mapping risks, interpreting wellbeing measures within their limits, and choosing work-design controls. They also learn to structure supportive conversations and track actions using privacy-aware approaches, treating workplace indicators as evidence for action rather than clinical diagnoses.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess work-related stress, shape working conditions, or coordinate workplace mental health responses. It suits intermediate learners with relevant workplace responsibilities who want to apply psychosocial risk methods in their operating context.
modules: WHO Guidance and Workplace Response Pathways
Digital Wellbeing Data and Privacy Controls
prerequisites: Prior experience in HR, occupational health and safety, people management, employee wellbeing, or a related workplace function is recommended. No clinical qualification or coding experience is required. Bring familiarity with your organization’s general work processes; no personal health information is needed for course exercises.
